circle_of_fifths/resources/html/circle_e.title: Exercise
circle_of_fifths/resources/html/circle_e.line: You get a key; tap how many sharps or flats it has, then tap its notes on the staff. Easy, medium and hard allow 5, 3 or 1 wrong tries

circle_of_fifths/resources/html/circle_e.title: Exercise
circle_of_fifths/resources/html/circle_e.line: The two neighbours and the opposite key of any key

circle_of_fifths/resources/html/circle_e.title: Exercise
circle_of_fifths/resources/html/circle_e.line: From a signature to its major key and its relative minor

circle_of_fifths/resources/html/circle_o.title: The circle of fifths
circle_of_fifths/resources/html/circle_o.line: Click a key to see its signature, its scale on the keys, and which keys sit next to it. Play sounds the scale

music_instruments/resources/html/interva.title: Ear exercise
music_instruments/resources/html/interva.line: Two notes sound together and the lower one is lit. Find the higher one

music_instruments/resources/html/interva.title: Ear exercise
music_instruments/resources/html/interva.line: Two notes sound one after the other and the first is lit. Find the second on the keyboard. Choose easy, medium or hard; the score stays on the page until you reload

music_instruments/resources/html/interva.title: Ear exercise
music_instruments/resources/html/interva.line: A three-note chord sounds and the lowest note is lit. Find the other two

music_instruments/resources/html/tune_sh.title: The same tune from different starting notes
music_instruments/resources/html/tune_sh.line: The notes change, the gaps between them stay

music_instruments/resources/html/whole_h.title: Click two keys to see
music_instruments/resources/html/whole_h.line: Click two keys to see the gap between them as whole steps and half steps

scales/resources/html/scale_build_major..title: Exercise
scales/resources/html/scale_build_major..line: Choose a tonic and tap the keys of the scale; the staff fills in as you find the notes. At the end you see the whole scale and can press Play

scales/resources/html/scale_build_modes_.title: Exercise
scales/resources/html/scale_build_modes_.line: Choose a tonic and tap the keys of the scale; the staff fills in as you find the notes. Easy, medium and hard allow 5, 3 or 1 wrong taps. At the end you see the whole scale and can press Play

scales/resources/html/scale_build_natura.title: Exercise
scales/resources/html/scale_build_natura.line: Choose a tonic and tap the keys of the scale; the staff fills in as you find the notes. At the end you see the whole scale and can press Play

scales/resources/html/scale_build_other_.title: Exercise
scales/resources/html/scale_build_other_.line: Choose a tonic and tap the keys of the scale; the staff fills in as you find the notes. Easy, medium and hard allow 5, 3 or 1 wrong taps. At the end you see the whole scale and can press Play

scales/resources/html/scale_ear_build_th.title: Exercise
scales/resources/html/scale_ear_build_th.line: Choose a tonic and tap the keys of the scale; the staff fills in as you find the notes. Easy, medium and hard allow 5, 3 or 1 wrong taps. At the end you see the whole scale and can press Play. Any scale of this chapter can come up

scales/resources/html/scale_ear_name_the.title: Ear exercise
scales/resources/html/scale_ear_name_the.line: You hear a scale; name it. Choose easy, medium or hard

scales/resources/html/scale_player.html.title: Scale player
scales/resources/html/scale_player.html.line: Pick a tonic and a scale, press Play, and see and hear it on the keys and the staff

scales/resources/images/c_major_scale.sv.title: C major
scales/resources/images/c_major_scale.sv.line: The white keys from C to C, no sharps or flats

scales/resources/images/f_major_scale.sv.title: F major
scales/resources/images/f_major_scale.sv.line: The same recipe from F; the fourth note is B-flat, shown as a flat sign on the staff

scales/resources/images/g_major_scale.sv.title: G major
scales/resources/images/g_major_scale.sv.line: The same recipe from G; the seventh note is F-sharp, shown here as a sharp sign on the staff
